ValidationRule.description: Ensures term dates can only be set when a CEB Position is assigned, preventing orphaned term tracking
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK(TEXT(CEB_Position__c)), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(CEB_Term_Start__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(CEB_Term_End__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Last_Election_Date__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Term dates and election date can only be set when a CEB Position is assigned. Please select a CEB Position first.
